name: Shirien
source:
Being the most attractive dancer of the Show Salon Kamal, people call her the 'Queen of Dance'. 
She and her friend, Aisha, were saved from a terrible affair they were involved in by the owner of the shop. They now live in his show salon.
To heal the disease of the man who saved her, she became a spy and is now gathering ingredients for him to create a medicine.
She was taught that men can not 'love' her and can only feel 'lust' towards her. That way, she is able to properly analyze the situation and deal with it calmly when there is an emergency.
